requirement_text: If the items are in stock, the system shall display the items; if not, it shall display that the items are out of stock.
user_story: As a shopper, I want to see whether an item is in stock or out of stock, so that I know if I can get it.
technical_task: Display the item when it is in stock and an out-of-stock message when it is not, based on the item's stock status.
acceptance_criteria: Given an item that is in stock, when the item is displayed, then the system shows the item.
Given an item that is not in stock, when the item is displayed, then the system shows that the item is out of stock.
rationale: Role assumed: shopper. The two stock outcomes are stated in the requirement.

requirement_text: The user shall be able to create a new task by tapping the "+" icon in the bottom right corner of the screen.
user_story: As a user, I want to create a new task by tapping the "+" icon, so that I can add tasks quickly.
technical_task: Add a "+" icon in the bottom right corner of the screen that starts new task creation when tapped.
acceptance_criteria: Given the screen is displayed, when the user looks at the bottom right corner, then a "+" icon is visible.
Given the "+" icon is visible, when the user taps it, then a new task is created.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The benefit of quick task entry is inferred from the interaction described.

requirement_text: The NE shall start transmitting a sync message using class 2 exchanges once 3 fault tolerant clocks have synchronized, thus enabling inter-NE data exchanges.
requirement_text_raw: The NE shall (3.2.2.3.2) start transmitting a sync message using class 2 exchanges once 3 fault tolerant clocks have synchronized, thus enabling inter-NE data exchanges.
user_story: As a network engineer, I want the NE to start transmitting a sync message once 3 fault tolerant clocks have synchronized, so that inter-NE data exchanges are enabled.
technical_task: Start transmitting the sync message using class 2 exchanges in the NE once 3 fault tolerant clocks have synchronized.
acceptance_criteria: Given fewer than 3 fault tolerant clocks have synchronized, when the NE checks its clocks, then it does not start transmitting the sync message.
Given 3 fault tolerant clocks have synchronized, when the NE checks its clocks, then it starts transmitting the sync message using class 2 exchanges.
Given the sync message is being transmitted, when other NEs receive it, then inter-NE data exchanges are enabled.
rationale: Role assumed: network engineer. The condition, message type and outcome come from the requirement.

requirement_text: User's personal information shall be securely stored to prevent identity theft.
user_story: As a user, I want my personal information to be stored securely, so that it cannot be used for identity theft.
technical_task: Store users' personal information using secure storage controls so that it is protected against unauthorized access.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user's personal information is saved, when it is stored, then it is stored using secure storage.
Given stored personal information, when someone without authorization tries to access it, then access is denied.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The specific security mechanism is not stated, so the task stays at the level of secure storage.

requirement_text: The system shall move the request to the Approval Workflow upon clicking the Approve Button.
user_story: As an approver, I want a request to move to the Approval Workflow when I click the Approve Button, so that approval proceeds.
technical_task: Move the request into the Approval Workflow when the Approve Button is clicked.
acceptance_criteria: Given a request awaiting approval, when the approver clicks the Approve Button, then the request is moved to the Approval Workflow.
Given a request that has not been approved, when no one clicks the Approve Button, then the request is not moved to the Approval Workflow.
rationale: Role assumed: approver.

requirement_text: System shall offer video editing tools such as trim, cut, crop, merge, copy/duplicate, collage, and looping video clips on the storyboard.
user_story: As a video creator, I want editing tools to trim, cut, crop, merge, duplicate, collage and loop clips on the storyboard, so that I can edit my video.
technical_task: Provide trim, cut, crop, merge, copy/duplicate, collage and looping tools for video clips on the storyboard.
acceptance_criteria: Given a video clip on the storyboard, when the creator opens the editing tools, then trim, cut, crop, merge, copy/duplicate, collage and looping are available.
Given a clip on the storyboard, when the creator applies one of the tools, then the clip is changed accordingly on the storyboard.
rationale: Role assumed: video creator. The tool list is taken directly from the requirement.

requirement_text: The solution should provide the ability to extract data for public health purposes.
user_story: As a public health officer, I want to extract data from the solution for public health purposes, so that it can support public health work.
technical_task: Provide a data extraction capability in the solution that can export data for public health purposes.
acceptance_criteria: Given data held in the solution, when an authorized user requests an extraction for public health purposes, then the data is extracted.
Given a data extraction request, when the extraction completes, then the extracted data is available to the requester.
rationale: Role assumed: public health officer. Which data and format are not specified.

requirement_text: The system shall sense any music playing, create an audio fingerprint, and compare it against the database.
user_story: As a listener, I want the system to recognize music that is playing, so that I can identify it.
technical_task: Capture the audio of any music playing, create an audio fingerprint, and compare it against the database.
acceptance_criteria: Given music is playing, when the system senses it, then the system creates an audio fingerprint.
Given an audio fingerprint, when the system compares it, then the comparison is made against the database.
rationale: Role assumed: listener. The benefit is inferred; the requirement states only the sense, fingerprint and compare steps.

requirement_text: The details of the simulations as well as the data exchange process are set forth in the following.
rationale: The sentence points to details elsewhere and states no behaviour the system must provide.
clarification_questions: Which simulations do the details refer to?
What does "the following" refer to?

requirement_text: The system shall allow indicating external descriptions and versions of objects.
user_story: As a user, I want to indicate external descriptions and versions of objects, so that this information is recorded with each object.
technical_task: Add fields to objects for external descriptions and versions and allow users to enter them.
acceptance_criteria: Given an object, when the user enters an external description, then the description is saved with the object.
Given an object, when the user enters a version, then the version is saved with the object.
rationale: Role assumed: user. What counts as an external description is not defined.

requirement_text: A user (a patient patient representative or LHCP) views the number of unread messages from his or her message inbox.
requirement_text_raw: A user (a patient  patient representative  or LHCP) views the number of unread messages from his or her message inbox.
user_story: As a patient or patient representative, I want to view the number of unread messages in my inbox, so that I know how many messages still need attention.
technical_task: Show the count of unread messages on the message inbox for patients, patient representatives and LHCPs.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user with unread messages, when the user views the message inbox, then the number of unread messages is shown.
Given a user with no unread messages, when the user views the message inbox, then the unread count shows that there are none.
rationale: The requirement names the user types; the second criterion covers the empty case.

requirement_text: If this parameter is false no internet details will be requested.
rationale: The parameter and the internet details are not identified, so behaviour cannot be specified.
clarification_questions: Which parameter is meant?
What internet details are requested otherwise?

requirement_text: Any makefiles or other automated scripts that support the build, down-load, and flash programming processes shall be delivered with the software to NASA.
requirement_text_raw: Any makefiles or other automated scripts that support the build, down-load, and flash programming processes shall (3.3.7.2) be delivered with the software to NASA.
user_story: As a NASA project owner, I want makefiles and automated scripts for the build, download and flash programming processes delivered with the software, so that I can rebuild and load it myself.
technical_task: Include all makefiles and automated scripts that support the build, download and flash programming processes in the software delivery to NASA.
acceptance_criteria: Given the software delivery package, when it is prepared for NASA, then it contains the makefiles and scripts for the build process.
Given the software delivery package, when it is prepared for NASA, then it contains the scripts for the download and flash programming processes.
rationale: Role assumed: NASA project owner.

requirement_text: The system shall have a simple yet high-quality user interface.
rationale: "Simple" and "high-quality" are subjective and not measurable.
clarification_questions: What makes an interface "simple" and "high-quality" here?
How will the quality be judged?

requirement_text: Clear instructions and tooltips shall be provided where necessary to guide users through different features and processes.
user_story: As a user, I want clear instructions and tooltips where I need them, so that I can find my way around the features and processes.
technical_task: Add instructions and tooltips to features and processes where users need guidance.
acceptance_criteria: Given a feature that needs guidance, when the user opens it, then clear instructions or tooltips are shown.
Given a tooltip is available, when the user points at the related element, then the tooltip is displayed.
rationale: Role assumed: user. Which places count as "where necessary" is left to design.

requirement_text: The Scheduler in the FTPP shall keep all redundant copies of a process, which are executing in different computers, in synchronization.
requirement_text_raw: The Scheduler in the FTPP shall (3.3.4.16) keep all redundant copies of a process, which are executing in different computers, in synchronization.
user_story: As a system integrator, I want the Scheduler in the FTPP to keep all redundant copies of a process synchronized, so that copies running in different computers stay consistent.
technical_task: Make the FTPP Scheduler keep every redundant copy of a process, executing in different computers, in synchronization.
acceptance_criteria: Given redundant copies of a process executing in different computers, when the Scheduler runs, then the copies are kept in synchronization.
Given a process with redundant copies, when one copy advances, then the other copies stay synchronized with it.
rationale: Role assumed: system integrator.

requirement_text: The system shall offer various order fulfillment options (in-store pickup, delivery).
user_story: As a customer, I want to choose between in-store pickup and delivery, so that I can receive my order the way that suits me.
technical_task: Offer in-store pickup and delivery as order fulfillment options in the ordering process.
acceptance_criteria: Given an order being placed, when the customer selects a fulfillment option, then in-store pickup and delivery are offered.
Given the customer selects one option, when the order is confirmed, then the order uses the chosen fulfillment option.
rationale: Role assumed: customer. "Various" is read as the two listed options.

requirement_text: User shall be able to configure application settings according to state requirements.
user_story: As a user, I want to configure application settings according to state requirements, so that the application meets what my state requires.
technical_task: Provide application settings that can be configured to match state requirements.
acceptance_criteria: Given the application settings, when a user opens them, then settings related to state requirements can be configured.
Given a changed setting, when the user saves it, then the application uses the configured value.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The state requirements themselves are not specified.

requirement_text: User shall/will be able to perform online balance checks.
user_story: As a customer, I want to check my balance online, so that I can see how much I have.
technical_task: Provide an online balance check function for users.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user is signed in, when the user requests a balance check online, then the balance is displayed.
Given a user is not signed in, when the user requests a balance check, then the balance is not shown.
rationale: Role assumed: customer. The sign-in criterion is an assumption about access, not stated in the requirement.

requirement_text: All functionality must be thoroughly tested through comprehensive test cases.
rationale: "Thoroughly" and "comprehensive" are subjective and no coverage target is given.
clarification_questions: What counts as "thoroughly" and "comprehensive" testing?
Which functionality is in scope, and what coverage is expected?

requirement_text: System shall facilitate the import of EAD data into the application.
user_story: As an archivist, I want to import EAD data into the application, so that I can work with existing descriptions.
technical_task: Implement an import function that reads EAD data into the application.
acceptance_criteria: Given a file of EAD data, when the user imports it, then the data is available in the application.
Given a file that is not valid EAD data, when the user imports it, then the import is refused with an error message.
rationale: Role assumed: archivist. The error handling criterion is an assumption.

requirement_text: The system shall meet the minimum requirements to allow for successful activation of Adobe Illustrator and access to all features.
rationale: The minimum requirements are not stated, so they cannot be tested.
clarification_questions: What are the minimum requirements for activation?
Which features of Adobe Illustrator must be accessible?

requirement_text: User shall be able to see which summits they're signed up for, to confirm attendance.
user_story: As an attendee, I want to see which summits I have signed up for, so that I can confirm my attendance.
technical_task: Show a user the summits they are signed up for, with a way to confirm attendance.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user signed up for summits, when the user opens their summits, then the summits they signed up for are listed.
Given a listed summit, when the user confirms attendance, then the confirmation is recorded.
rationale: Role assumed: attendee.

requirement_text: The user shall be able to enter the Module for the exam.
user_story: As a student, I want to enter the Module for the exam, so that I can take the exam.
technical_task: Allow users to enter the Module for the exam.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user who has access to the exam, when the user opens the Module for the exam, then the user enters the Module.
Given the Module for the exam, when the user selects it, then it opens.
rationale: Role assumed: student. What the Module contains is not described.

requirement_text: VS Code shall be downloadable as a file smaller than 200 MB.
user_story: As a developer, I want VS Code to be downloadable as a file smaller than 200 MB, so that the download is manageable.
technical_task: Package VS Code for download as a single file smaller than 200 MB.
acceptance_criteria: Given the VS Code download, when its file size is checked, then the size is smaller than 200 MB.
Given the download page, when a user downloads VS Code, then it is delivered as a file.
rationale: Role assumed: developer. The size limit of 200 MB is taken from the requirement.

requirement_text: VS Code shall require a full operating system when running in a virtual machine environment.
user_story: As an administrator, I want VS Code to require a full operating system in a virtual machine, so that its runtime needs are clear.
technical_task: Document and enforce that VS Code requires a full operating system when running in a virtual machine environment.
acceptance_criteria: Given a virtual machine environment, when VS Code is installed, then it requires a full operating system.
Given a virtual machine without a full operating system, when VS Code is started, then it does not run.
rationale: Role assumed: administrator. The second criterion is an interpretation of "shall require".

requirement_text: Second field will be date of task completion.
rationale: The sentence refers to a "second field" without saying where it is, and gives no behaviour.
clarification_questions: Which form or screen is this second field on?
What format should the date of task completion have?

requirement_text: An application programming interface shall be documented in a FTSS API document.
requirement_text_raw: An application programming interface shall (3.3.13.3) be documented in a FTSS API document.
user_story: As a developer, I want the application programming interface documented in a FTSS API document, so that I can learn how to use it.
technical_task: Write a FTSS API document that describes the application programming interface.
acceptance_criteria: Given the FTSS API document, when a developer reads it, then the application programming interface is documented in it.
Given the application programming interface, when it changes, then the FTSS API document is kept consistent with it.
rationale: Role assumed: developer. The second criterion extends the requirement slightly.

requirement_text: Frequently-executed transactions must be completed with minimal interactions.
rationale: "Minimal" and "frequently-executed" are not defined.
clarification_questions: How many interactions count as "minimal"?
Which transactions are "frequently executed"?

requirement_text: System shall output request to turn on or off heating or cooling unit based on temperature data.
user_story: As a home occupant, I want the system to request heating or cooling to be switched on or off based on temperature data, so that the temperature is controlled.
technical_task: Output a request to turn the heating or cooling unit on or off based on the temperature data.
acceptance_criteria: Given temperature data, when the system evaluates it, then it outputs a request to turn the heating or cooling unit on or off.
Given the system outputs a request, when the request is sent, then it targets the heating or cooling unit.
rationale: Role assumed: home occupant. The thresholds that trigger a request are not specified.

requirement_text: Upon successful authentication the user will be directed to a personalized home page based on their role.
requirement_text_raw: Upon successful authentication  the user will be directed to a personalized home page based on their role.
user_story: As an authenticated user, I want to be directed to a personalized home page based on my role, so that I see what is relevant to me.
technical_task: After successful authentication, redirect the user to a home page personalized by the user's role.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user who authenticates successfully, when authentication completes, then the user is directed to a personalized home page.
Given two users with different roles, when each authenticates, then each home page is personalized to that user's role.
rationale: The benefit is inferred from the personalization described.

requirement_text: Employee shall receive quick notifications for prompt action.
rationale: "Quick" and "prompt" are not measurable and the notification trigger is missing.
clarification_questions: What counts as a "quick" notification?
What action is meant by "prompt action"?

requirement_text: Card reader shall be a magnetic stripe reader with Smart card option and include an extra indentation for card polarization.
user_story: As a customer service operator, I want a card reader that is a magnetic stripe reader with a smart card option and an extra indentation for card polarization, so that cards are inserted correctly.
technical_task: Specify a magnetic stripe card reader with a smart card option and an extra indentation for card polarization.
acceptance_criteria: Given the card reader, when it is inspected, then it is a magnetic stripe reader.
Given the card reader, when it is inspected, then it has a smart card option and an extra indentation for card polarization.
rationale: Role assumed: customer service operator. The hardware features come from the requirement.

requirement_text: The CT shall also contain time-outs and vote masks.
requirement_text_raw: The CT shall (3.2.2.2.2) also contain time-outs and vote masks.
rationale: "CT", the time-outs and the vote masks are not explained, and "also" refers to context not provided.
clarification_questions: What does CT stand for?
What are the time-outs and vote masks used for?

requirement_text: The system shall prioritize WiFi connection and automatically switch to mobile network when WiFi is unavailable.
user_story: As a mobile user, I want the system to prefer WiFi and switch to the mobile network when WiFi is unavailable, so that I stay connected.
technical_task: Prioritize the WiFi connection and automatically switch to the mobile network when WiFi is unavailable.
acceptance_criteria: Given WiFi and the mobile network are both available, when the system connects, then it uses WiFi.
Given WiFi becomes unavailable, when the system loses it, then it automatically switches to the mobile network.
rationale: Role assumed: mobile user.

requirement_text: All radiation test results shall be characterized and documented.
requirement_text_raw: All radiation test results shall (3.2.3.1.3.3.7) be characterized and documented.
user_story: As a project manager, I want all radiation test results characterized and documented, so that the test outcomes are on record.
technical_task: Characterize and document every radiation test result.
acceptance_criteria: Given a radiation test result, when the test is completed, then the result is characterized.
Given a characterized radiation test result, when the work is finished, then it is documented.
rationale: Role assumed: project manager.

requirement_text: A patient or personal health representative can answer any of the following questions relative to a previous (in UC9 S1) office visit according to Data Format 6.13.
requirement_text_raw: A patient or personal health representative can answer any of the following questions relative to a previous (in UC9  S1) office visit according to Data Format 6.13.
rationale: "The following questions" are not provided and the data format and use case steps are referenced but not described.
clarification_questions: Which questions can the patient or representative answer?
What does Data Format 6.13 specify?

requirement_text: System shall maintain response time under 100 milliseconds for normal workload conditions.
user_story: As a user, I want the system to respond in under 100 milliseconds under normal workload, so that it feels responsive.
technical_task: Keep system response time under 100 milliseconds for normal workload conditions.
acceptance_criteria: Given a normal workload, when a request is made, then the response time is under 100 milliseconds.
Given a normal workload over a period of use, when response times are measured, then they stay under 100 milliseconds.
rationale: Role assumed: user. What counts as a normal workload is not defined.

requirement_text: System shall analyze emails and categorize them automatically into primary, social, or promotional categories.
user_story: As an email user, I want my emails analyzed and sorted automatically into primary, social or promotional categories, so that I can find important mail easily.
technical_task: Analyze incoming emails and categorize them automatically as primary, social or promotional.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new email, when the system analyzes it, then the email is assigned to primary, social or promotional.
Given categorized emails, when the user opens a category, then it lists the emails assigned to it.
rationale: Role assumed: email user.

requirement_text: System shall be able to indicate the current day on the calendar.
user_story: As a calendar user, I want the current day to be indicated on the calendar, so that I can see today's date at a glance.
technical_task: Highlight the current day on the calendar view.
acceptance_criteria: Given the calendar is displayed, when the user views the current month, then the current day is indicated.
Given the date changes, when the calendar is displayed on the new day, then the indicator moves to the new day.
rationale: Role assumed: calendar user.

requirement_text: The component design shall allow to upgrade in a later design step to larger memory with the same footprint and the same interface without PCB modification.
user_story: As a hardware designer, I want the component design to allow an upgrade to larger memory with the same footprint and interface, so that I can upgrade without changing the board.
technical_task: Design the component so larger memory with the same footprint and the same interface can be fitted later without PCB modification.
acceptance_criteria: Given the component design, when larger memory with the same footprint and interface is fitted in a later design step, then no PCB modification is needed.
Given the larger memory, when it is fitted, then it uses the same interface as the original memory.
rationale: Role assumed: hardware designer.

requirement_text: The system shall utilize separate databases for cars and customers.
user_story: As a system architect, I want separate databases for cars and customers, so that the two kinds of data are kept apart.
technical_task: Use one database for cars and a separate database for customers.
acceptance_criteria: Given car data, when it is stored, then it is stored in the cars database.
Given customer data, when it is stored, then it is stored in the customers database, separate from car data.
rationale: Role assumed: system architect. The reason for separation is inferred.

requirement_text: The user shall be able to select the option of view incompleted tasks.
user_story: As a user, I want to select the option to view incomplete tasks, so that I can see what is still to be done.
technical_task: Add an option that lets users view only incomplete tasks.
acceptance_criteria: Given a list of tasks, when the user selects the option to view incomplete tasks, then only incomplete tasks are shown.
Given the option is selected, when a task is completed, then it is no longer listed.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The second criterion is an assumption about how the view updates.

requirement_text: The solution should be able to support time synchronization using NTP or SNTP and use this synchronized time in all security records of time.
requirement_text_raw: The solution should be able to support time synchronization using NTP or SNTP  and use this synchronized time in all security records of time.
user_story: As a security administrator, I want the solution to support time synchronization using NTP or SNTP, so that the time in all security records is consistent.
technical_task: Support time synchronization using NTP or SNTP and use the synchronized time in all security records of time.
acceptance_criteria: Given an NTP or SNTP time source, when the solution synchronizes its clock, then time synchronization is performed.
Given a security record is created, when its time is recorded, then it uses the synchronized time.
rationale: Role assumed: security administrator.

requirement_text: Any user who creates or joins a game will be able to upload their own JPEG or GIF image that they wish to have displayed above their name, if they do not wish to use a preset icon.
user_story: As a game player, I want to upload my own JPEG or GIF image to display above my name, so that I don't have to use a preset icon.
technical_task: Allow a user who creates or joins a game to upload a JPEG or GIF image shown above their name, as an alternative to a preset icon.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user who creates or joins a game, when the user uploads a JPEG or GIF image, then the image is displayed above the user's name.
Given a user who does not upload an image, when the user chooses a preset icon, then the preset icon is displayed instead.
rationale: Role assumed: game player.

requirement_text: LMS product shall handle both expected and unexpected errors to prevent loss of information and minimize downtime.
user_story: As a LMS administrator, I want the LMS product to handle expected and unexpected errors, so that information is not lost and downtime is minimized.
technical_task: Handle both expected and unexpected errors in the LMS product in a way that prevents loss of information.
acceptance_criteria: Given an expected error occurs, when the LMS handles it, then no information is lost.
Given an unexpected error occurs, when the LMS handles it, then no information is lost and downtime is kept as short as possible.
rationale: Role assumed: LMS administrator. How much downtime is acceptable is not stated.

requirement_text: System shall provide information on the responsible party for each DMP.
user_story: As a data steward, I want the system to show the responsible party for each DMP, so that I know who is in charge of it.
technical_task: Display the responsible party on each DMP record.
acceptance_criteria: Given a DMP, when a user views it, then the responsible party is shown.
Given two different DMPs with different responsible parties, when each is viewed, then each shows its own responsible party.
rationale: Role assumed: data steward. The term DMP is kept as written.

requirement_text: FTSS shall provide "immediate" message passing services in the form of "pipes". "Pipes" provide fast data throughput between virtual groups or within a virtual group when minimal data latency is necessary.
requirement_text_raw: FTSS shall [SRS226] provide "immediate" message passing services in the form of "pipes". "Pipes" provide fast data throughput between virtual groups or within a virtual group when minimal data latency is necessary.
user_story: As a software developer, I want FTSS to provide "immediate" message passing services in the form of "pipes", so that data moves fast between virtual groups when minimal data latency is necessary.
technical_task: Provide "immediate" message passing services in FTSS as "pipes" for data throughput between virtual groups or within a virtual group.
acceptance_criteria: Given two virtual groups, when a message is sent through a "pipe", then it is passed between the groups.
Given a "pipe" within one virtual group, when a message is sent through it, then it is passed within that virtual group.
rationale: Role assumed: software developer. How fast "fast" is is not specified.

requirement_text: Extensive usage statistics for various categories shall be accessible.
user_story: As a manager, I want to access usage statistics for various categories, so that I can see how the system is used.
technical_task: Provide access to usage statistics grouped by category.
acceptance_criteria: Given usage data has been collected, when a user opens the statistics, then usage statistics are shown for the categories.
Given a category, when a user selects it, then the statistics for that category are displayed.
rationale: Role assumed: manager. The categories are not listed.

requirement_text: The system shall allow editing items in the estimation list.
user_story: As a user, I want to edit items in the estimation list, so that I can correct my estimates.
technical_task: Allow users to edit items in the estimation list.
acceptance_criteria: Given an item in the estimation list, when the user edits it, then the changes are saved.
Given an edited item, when the list is displayed again, then the item shows the new values.
rationale: Role assumed: user.
